vistas.primerosPasos: Follow the first steps to start monitoring.
vistas.adminRegistra: An Admin has to register them.
vistas.inicio.tardan: The data is taking a while to arrive. You may be offline.
vistas.inicio.detenida: The routine is stopped. {d}: what you see may be out of date.
vistas.inicio.ultimaErrores: The last run finished with collection errors.
vistas.inicio.reglasOrigen: From incident responses, from similarity between processes or from the daily review.
vistas.inicio.proyPropuestosSub: Folders with processes found by the Orchestrator scan.
vistas.inicio.cambiosSugSub: The routine's daily review found rules to adjust.
vistas.inicio.revisarAltaSub: The initial analysis is done. Review it and turn on monitoring.
vistas.inicio.altaFallo: The onboarding or the monitoring failed.
vistas.inicio.sinIncidentes: There are no incidents that need action.
vistas.inicio.sinCoincidencias: No open issue matches the search.
vistas.inicio.sinTemasVista: There are no issues in this view.
vistas.fuera.sub: Open issues not shown in the inbox: those the team snoozed, responded to or dismissed, and those the triage decided not to report.
vistas.fuera.sinMotivo: There are no issues with that reason.
vistas.fuera.todoEnBandeja: Everything open is in the inbox.
vistas.corridas.sub: Each execution of the routine, with what it checked and what it found.
vistas.corridas.vacioProy: No recent run included this project.
vistas.corridas.vacioPrimera: They appear here when the routine runs for the first time.
vistas.corrida.noEsta: It is not among the last 50 runs.
vistas.corrida.noIncluyo: This run did not include it.
vistas.corrida.senales: {jobs} jobs · {logs} error/fatal logs · {fallidos} failed items · {aband} abandoned
vistas.proyectos.subResto: Each one keeps its own memory, rules and inventory.
vistas.proyectos.propone.one: The routine proposes {n} project to add: an Orchestrator folder with processes that are not monitored yet.
vistas.proyectos.propone.other: The routine proposes {n} projects to add: Orchestrator folders with processes that are not monitored yet.
vistas.proyectos.buscar: Search project by name or folder
vistas.disc.posponerAviso: The discrepancy is no longer pending until that date.
vistas.disc.descartarAviso: The routine records it in the project memory and does not show it again as new.
vistas.disc.notasPlaceholder: What will be fixed, who takes it or why it is fine as is
vistas.disc.ticketAria: Ticket or reference for the fix
vistas.disc.ticketPlaceholder: Ticket or reference for the fix (optional)
vistas.disc.responderAviso: It is kept in the project production memory.
vistas.disc.sinDiscrepancias: No discrepancies. The project analysis cross-checks the code, the documentation and Orchestrator: whatever does not match appears here.
vistas.disc.ningunaPendiente: None pending: they are responded to, dismissed, snoozed or resolved.
vistas.disc.noVanBandeja: Discrepancies do not go to the inbox: they are worked on from here.
vistas.docs.enmascaro.one: {n} item was masked (emails, IDs or users).
vistas.docs.enmascaro.other: {n} items were masked (emails, IDs or users).
vistas.docs.pegaAqui: Paste the document text here (Markdown or plain text)
vistas.docs.sinPersonales: The dashboard does not store personal data: remove any names of people, phone numbers or ID numbers left in the text. Images are not stored.
vistas.docs.intro: PDD, SDD, Runbook and any other document of the project. The routine uses them in the project analysis and in the pre-analysis of each issue, together with the documentation that comes in the published packages. Everything is stored as Markdown.
vistas.docs.reanalisisSub: So that the process memory picks up the changes in the documentation.
vistas.docs.formatoNoConv: That format cannot be converted here: save it as .docx or PDF, or paste the text.
vistas.docs.formatoNoAdm: Unsupported format: upload a .docx, .pdf, .md or .txt file, or paste the text.
vistas.docs.noLeyoDocx: The .docx could not be read. Save it again from Word, or paste the text.
vistas.docs.noLeyo: The file could not be read.
vistas.docs.pdfAviso: From a PDF only the text is recovered, not the formatting: check the headings, and tables end up as running text.
vistas.docs.quitarPreg: Remove this document from the project? This cannot be undone.
vistas.docs.pkgNota: The routine reads them on its own, in the deployed version. A disabled one is not used in the project analysis or in the analysis of issues.
vistas.docs.ninguno: No documents have been uploaded yet.
vistas.docs.noLeyoPdf: The PDF could not be read. Try again, or paste the text.
vistas.docs.pdfVacio: The PDF has no text to read (is it scanned?). Paste the text.
